glosses: to make a low or subdued noise while walking

examples.text: We hoorden mensen in het appartement boven ons stommelen.
examples.translation: We heard people in the apartment above us make soft noises as they walked.
examples.english: We heard people in the apartment above us make soft noises as they walked.
